whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first student day moves from August 18 in 2025–26 to August 24 in 2026–27.
The scheduled last student day moves from June 12 to June 17.
Thanksgiving Break moves one day earlier, from November 26–28 to November 25–27. Winter Break also moves one day earlier, from December 22–January 2 to December 21–January 1.
Spring Break remains a five-weekday break but moves from March 30–April 3 to March 22–26. A teacher workday follows the break in both years.
Eid al-Fitr moves from March 20 to March 10, and Eid al-Adha moves from May 27 to May 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for PWCS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for PWCS students is Monday, August 24, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PWCS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: PWCS Winter Break runs Monday, December 21, 2026, through Friday, January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is PWCS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: PWCS Spring Break runs Monday, March 22, through Friday, March 26, 2027. A teacher workday follows on March 29, so students return Tuesday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for PWCS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day of school for PWCS students is Thursday, June 17, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does PWCS close for Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. PWCS schools and offices are closed for Eid al-Fitr on March 10 and Eid al-Adha on May 17. The district also closes for Yom Kippur on September 21.

calendarFaqs.q: Can families subscribe to the official PWCS calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: PWCS provides an official academic-calendar subscription for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, and other calendar apps. Unlike a one-time calendar download, the subscription can receive later district updates automatically.

calendarFaqs.q: Is PWCS the same as Manassas City Public Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Prince William County Public Schools, Manassas City Public Schools, and Manassas Park City Schools are separate school divisions with different calendars. Families should confirm their assigned division using their exact address.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 9, 2026, against the current PWCS school-calendar page, both official 2026–27 PDFs, the official subscription instructions, and the district's calendar-approval announcement.
sourceReviewDetails: The first and last student days, districtwide holidays, teacher workdays, and break dates were checked against PWCS sources.
The 180 instructional-day total is calculated from the scheduled student calendar.
Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break are shown as student break ranges. Adjacent teacher workdays are listed separately and are not added to the break duration.
The March 29 teacher workday means students return Tuesday, March 30 after Spring Break.
Yom Kippur, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha are districtwide school and office closures. Juneteenth falls after the scheduled last student day.
The MySchoolDates ICS file is a one-time snapshot. The official PWCS academic-calendar subscription is the better option for receiving later district updates automatically.
Year-over-year notes compare equivalent student dates and do not treat an adjacent teacher workday as part of Spring Break.

calendarNotes: PWCS students begin school August 24, 2026, and the scheduled last student day is June 17, 2027. Thanksgiving Break runs November 25–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 1, and Spring Break runs March 22–26. A teacher workday follows Spring Break on March 29, so students return March 30. PWCS schools and offices are closed for Yom Kippur, Eid al-Fitr, and Eid al-Adha. Juneteenth falls after the scheduled student year. Families who want automatic district updates should use the official PWCS calendar subscription rather than the one-time MySchoolDates download.
